title: STASH Earl's Delight Latte - Dairy Free Plant Based Black Tea Concentrate - Caffeinated - 32 fl oz, 5 Servings

reviews.title: Delightful indeed!
reviews.body: Delicious tea. Other tea concentrates i've purchased are usually syrupy sweet with a one dimensional flavor profile. This tea concentrate is like a symphony in the mouth, various flavors come out to play like this really pleasant almond tone that comes out  This really is a delightful tea! Pro tip: This works better with dairy milk. Tried a bunch of non-dairy options and tasted flat, almost like drinking the concentrate alone. Not sure what it is, maybe the fat in the milk brings out all the complex flavor nuances better.

reviews.title: Undrinkably sweet
reviews.body: Even with a 50/50 dilution with milk, it's too sweet for me to get past one or two sips. To give a comparison, it tastes like it has roughly twice as much sugar and sweetness as a Starbucks London fog latte, and is maybe 50% more sweet than any of their signature lattes. I also found the almond flavoring pretty unpleasant and atypical for this sort of drink, but that's on me for not noticing the almond flavor label on the front. So, unless I can find someone with an astronomical sweet tolerance or who is just hell-bent on type 2 diabetes, I'm going to have to throw the rest out.

features: Single Pack of STASH Earl's Delight Latte - Dairy Free Plant Based Black Tea Concentrate - Caffeinated and Ready-to-Drink
CLASSIC LONDON FOG LATTE: Packed with flavors of black tea, sweet almond, and bergamot, the perfect companion for a moment of bliss. 5 servings per carton.
DAIRY FREE & PLANT BASED: Shake well. Mix together equal parts tea latte concentrate and milk of your choice. Enjoy hot or iced.

EXPERTLY CRAFTED: STASH tea latte concentrates are lovingly crafted and harmoniously blended by tea blend masters. We use select plant botanicals that are Non-GMO. That's a whole lot of wholesome goodness in every sip.
STASH was brought to life by two tea-obsessed hippies in Portland, OR, in the 1970s. We're proudly family-owned, minority-owned, and woman-led.
